prompt:
Editorial studio portrait photograph for a premium website, fictional person (not a real or famous person). Lit by one hard magenta-tinted spotlight as a rim light from upper left and a soft warm gold fill from the right, pitch-black background, high contrast, rich saturated color, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, true photographic detail. Vertical framing. No text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no emblems, no stripes or trademarks on clothing or equipment, no watermark, no border, no rounded corners, the photo fills the frame edge to edge. Head and chest framing with the microphone visible, face in the upper third, eyes not looking at the camera.
Subject: a clear, articulate fictional Korean man in his early 30s with thin black-rimmed glasses and wavy black hair, crisp plain white shirt under a plain blue denim jacket. Pose: seated, turned three-quarters to the right toward a silver studio condenser microphone with a black pop filter on the right side of the frame, mid-sentence; his right hand (the hand nearer the camera) is raised at chest height in a relaxed open explaining gesture, palm facing up and slightly toward the microphone, the hand is empty with nothing held in it, thumb and four fingers clearly separated, gently curved and naturally spaced, wrist connected to a visible denim sleeve cuff; the other arm rests down out of frame. No pen, no paper, no objects in his hands. Lecture narrator mood.
Anatomy and realism requirements: exactly one person in the frame with exactly two arms and two hands; every visible hand has exactly five fingers (one thumb and four fingers) with natural knuckles, correct finger lengths and natural nail placement; natural joints, natural shoulder width and realistic human proportions; no extra, missing, fused or duplicated limbs or fingers; limbs and fingers never merge with the microphone, stand, cable, pop filter, headphones or any prop; simple plain clothing with no straps, no tangled cords, no lanyards; headphone cable hangs straight and separate from the body.
